hook: The chiller is dead. Nobody noticed.

beats.say: Nvidia now rates its parts for forty-five degree liquid inlets, up from the thirty to thirty-five degrees liquid cooling has lived with for years.
At forty-five degrees, rooftop dry coolers can reject the heat on their own, so new data centers no longer need chillers, those huge rooftop refrigerators.
Cooling energy falls by fifty to seventy percent, total data center power by ten to twenty percent, and water use by eighty to ninety-five percent.
